local-exec.command:
if [[ $(hostname) == morgenmuffel ]]; then
    closure=$(nix-store --verbose --realise ${ data.external.darwin_morgenmuffel_system.result.drv })
else
    export NIX_SSHOPTS="-o ControlMaster=auto -o ControlPath=/tmp/%C -o ControlPersist=60 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new "
    nix --extra-experimental-features "nix-command flakes" copy --derivation --to ssh-ng://morgenmuffel ${ data.external.darwin_morgenmuffel_system.result.drv }
    closure=$(ssh -o ControlMaster=auto -o ControlPath=/tmp/%C -o ControlPersist=60 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new morgenmuffel nix-store --verbose --realise ${ data.external.darwin_morgenmuffel_system.result.drv })
    nix --extra-experimental-features "nix-command flakes" copy --from ssh-ng://morgenmuffel "$closure"
fi

if [[ $(hostname) == morgenmuffel ]]; then
    sudo HOME=/var/root "$closure/activate"
else
    export NIX_SSHOPTS="-o ControlMaster=auto -o ControlPath=/tmp/%C -o ControlPersist=60 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new "
    nix --extra-experimental-features "nix-command flakes" copy --to ssh-ng://morgenmuffel "$closure"
    ssh -o ControlMaster=auto -o ControlPath=/tmp/%C -o ControlPersist=60 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new morgenmuffel sudo HOME=/var/root "$closure/activate"
fi
